	        if v:IsA("Decal") and v.Texture ~= "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=94941732665543" then
	            v.Parent = nil
	        elseif v:IsA("BasePart") then

	            Three.Texture = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=94941732665543"

	            Five.Texture = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=94941732665543"
	            Six.Texture = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=71944445506858"

	            Two.Face = "Back"
	            Three.Face = "Right"
	            Four.Face = "Left"
	            Five.Face = "Top"
	            Six.Face = "Bottom"
	        end
	        exPro(v)

local function RCTT_fake_script() -- TextButton1.PlaySoundOnButtonPressClient 
	local script = Instance.new('LocalScript', TextButton1)

	local button = script.Parent
	local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
	
	local SONG_ID = 76286178156432 -- Change this to your desired song ID
	
	local function playSound(songId)
	    for i, v in Workspace:GetChildren() do
	        if v.ClassName == "Sound" then
	            v:Stop()
	            v:Destroy()
	        end
	    end
	    local s = Instance.new("Sound")
	    s.Parent = Workspace
	    if songId then
	        s.SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(songId)
	    else
	        s.SoundId = "rbxassetid://76286178156432"
	    end
	    s.Volume = 10
	    s.Looped = true
	    s.Pitch = 0.26
	    s:Play()
	    task.wait(0.1)
	    s:Play()
	end
	
	button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	    playSound(SONG_ID)
	end)
	
	
end
coroutine.wrap(RCTT_fake_script)()

local function PHQFL_fake_script() -- ScrollingFrame.LocalScript 
	local script = Instance.new('LocalScript', ScrollingFrame)

	local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
	local runService = (game:GetService("RunService"));
	
	local gui = script.Parent
	
	local dragging
	local dragInput
	local dragStart
	local startPos
	
	function Lerp(a, b, m)
		return a + (b - a) * m
	end;
	
	local lastMousePos
	local lastGoalPos
	local DRAG_SPEED = (8); -- // The speed of the UI darg.
	function Update(dt)
		if not (startPos) then return end;
		if not (dragging) and (lastGoalPos) then
			gui.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, Lerp(gui.Position.X.Offset, lastGoalPos.X.Offset, dt * DRAG_SPEED), startPos.Y.Scale, Lerp(gui.Position.Y.Offset, lastGoalPos.Y.Offset, dt * DRAG_SPEED))
			return 
		end;
	
		local delta = (lastMousePos - UserInputService:GetMouseLocation())
		local xGoal = (startPos.X.Offset - delta.X);
		local yGoal = (startPos.Y.Offset - delta.Y);
		lastGoalPos = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, xGoal, startPos.Y.Scale, yGoal)
		gui.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, Lerp(gui.Position.X.Offset, xGoal, dt * DRAG_SPEED), startPos.Y.Scale, Lerp(gui.Position.Y.Offset, yGoal, dt * DRAG_SPEED))
	end;
	
	gui.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = true
			dragStart = input.Position
			startPos = gui.Position
			lastMousePos = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
	
			input.Changed:Connect(function()
				if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
					dragging = false
				end
			end)
		end
	end)
	
	gui.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragInput = input
		end
	end)
	
	runService.Heartbeat:Connect(Update)
end
coroutine.wrap(PHQFL_fake_script)()
